title: Flights with airline names
statementMd:
For flights 1 to 5, show the flight id and airline name.

Expected columns: `id`, `airline`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT f.id, a.name AS airline FROM flights f JOIN airlines a ON a.code = f.airline_code WHERE f.id <= 5;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
